# opnsense_acmeclient_account (Data Source)

ACME accounts (**Services ▸ ACME Client ▸ Accounts**, plugin `os-acme-client`). The account is registered with the CA when the first certificate is issued.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) UUID of the ACME account.

### Read-Only

- `ca` (String) The ACME CA that should be used for this account and all associated certificates. Note that some of them offer paid services and may require a subscription. Check the acme.sh documentation for a list of supported CAs. One of `buypass`, `buypass_test`, `google`, `google_test`, `letsencrypt`, `letsencrypt_test`, `sslcom`, `zerossl`, `custom`.
- `custom_ca` (String) The HTTPS URL of the custom ACME CA that should be used for this account and all associated certificates. If using your own CA, make sure the Root CA is added to OPNsense's trust store. For example: https://acme-v02.api.letsencrypt.org/directory or https://ca.internal/acme/directory.
- `description` (String) Description for this account.
- `eab_hmac` (String, Sensitive) An optional value provided by the CA when using ACME External Account Binding (EAB).
- `eab_kid` (String) An optional value provided by the CA when using ACME External Account Binding (EAB).
- `email` (String) Optional e-mail address for this account.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable this account.
- `name` (String) Name to identify this account.
